body:
Author-side corollary of unchanged §7, offered to the Slice-B reader (not a new independent verdict): at the exact aligned-planar scope, (1+12A²)/(1+A²)>=1 and D_aG0<=0. Since B<0, equation(13) therefore gives the model-independent leading-coefficient lower bound

`C2/C0 > 11 U2/(2I) = 4587/856`.

Strictness follows from positive Gaussian mass at a!=0. Consequently the leading coefficient of the radial TV/CDF error in(16) exceeds

`(4587/856)*(2/13)*(11/13)^(11/2)`

(approximately0.328937168357..., decimal diagnostic only). This is a bound on the asymptotic coefficient for each fixed model, NOT a uniform-in-L,k remainder or finite-threshold inequality.

Likewise (19) rewrites as `Bsign=(11 Uabs/(2I)) E_rho[|A|/sqrt(1+A²)]` with rho proportional to H gamma^11G0, so `0<Bsign<4587821/876544`. This is a simple finite upper bound, not a numerical evaluation of Bsign. Both rational factors were recomputed exactly. No manuscript/test/source bytes changed; all original A/B review bindings remain.
